title: Ignorinator
description: For use on MCC Island, auto-runs /ignore <player> when certain phrases are detected in chat
body:
# Ignorinator

![Friend says "67" and is immediately /ignored](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/9444a486148e8d7fe5b1b6b903f6d3621728a4a5.png)

At the request of one of my friends, this mod scans your chat for undesirable phrases and automatically `/ignore`s them on MCC Island.

(this mod is not endorsed by Noxcrew or anyone at MCCI!)

## Usage

By default, Ignorinator will only function when on `(play.)mccisland.net`. This can be configured using `/ignorinator set_server <ip>`.

You add phrases by running `/ignorinator add <phrase>` and remove them with `/ignorinator remove <phrase>`. You can see what phrases you already have down using `/ignorinator list`.

Finally, if you really wanna get fancy, you can configure how chat is read by using `/ignorinator set_parser <regex>`, where the argument is a valid regex expression with group 2 being a username and group 3 being the message content.
